+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright (c) 2018 Red Hat, Inc.
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1',
+                    'status': ['preview'],
+                    'supported_by': 'certified'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = '''
+---
+module: nios_fixed_address
+version_added: "2.9"
+author: "Ansible Community"
+short_description: Manage Infoblox NIOS DHCP fixed addresses
+description:
+  - Creates, updates, and removes IPv4 and IPv6 DHCP fixed addresses through
+    the Infoblox WAPI interface.
+requirements:
+  - infoblox-client
+extends_documentation_fragment: nios
+options:
+  name:
+    description:
+      - Name of the fixed address.
+    required: true
+  ipaddr:
+    description:
+      - IPv4 or IPv6 address to reserve.
+    required: true
+  mac:
+    description:
+      - MAC address associated with the reservation.
+    required: true
+  network:
+    description:
+      - Network containing the fixed address, in CIDR notation.
+    required: true
+  network_view:
+    description:
+      - Network view containing the fixed address.
+    default: default
+  options:
+    description:
+      - DHCP options to configure on the fixed address.
+    type: list
+    suboptions:
+      name:
+        description:
+          - DHCP option name. Supply this or C(num).
+      num:
+        description:
+          - DHCP option number. Supply this or C(name).
+        type: int
+      value:
+        description:
+          - DHCP option value.
+        required: true
+      use_option:
+        description:
+          - Whether to use this option.
+        type: bool
+        default: true
+      vendor_class:
+        description:
+          - DHCP vendor class.
+        default: DHCP
+  extattrs:
+    description:
+      - Extensible attributes as key and value pairs.
+    type: dict
+  comment:
+    description:
+      - Comment associated with the fixed address.
+  state:
+    description:
+      - Whether the fixed address should exist.
+    choices: [present, absent]
+    default: present
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Reserve an IPv4 address
+  nios_fixed_address:
+    name: printer
+    ipaddr: 192.0.2.10
+    mac: 00:11:22:33:44:55
+    network: 192.0.2.0/24
+    options:
+      - name: domain-name
+        value: example.com
+    provider:
+      host: "{{ inventory_hostname_short }}"
+      username: admin
+      password: "{{ nios_password }}"
+  connection: local
+
+- name: Remove an IPv6 fixed address
+  nios_fixed_address:
+    name: printer-v6
+    ipaddr: 2001:db8::10
+    mac: 00:11:22:33:44:55
+    network: 2001:db8::/64
+    state: absent
+    provider:
+      host: "{{ inventory_hostname_short }}"
+      username: admin
+      password: "{{ nios_password }}"
+  connection: local
+'''
+
+RETURN = ''' # '''
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
+from ansible.module_utils.six import iteritems
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import validate_ip_address, validate_ip_v6_address
+from ansible.module_utils.net_tools.nios.api import (WapiModule, NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS,
+                                                      NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS)
+
+
+def options(module):
+    '''Convert DHCP options to the WAPI representation.'''
+    result = []
+    for item in module.params['options']:
+        option = dict((key, value) for key, value in iteritems(item) if value is not None)
+        if 'name' not in option and 'num' not in option:
+            module.fail_json(msg='one of `name` or `num` is required for option value')
+        if 'value' not in option:
+            module.fail_json(msg='`value` is required for option value')
+        if 'use_option' not in item:
+            option['use_option'] = True
+        if 'vendor_class' not in item:
+            option['vendor_class'] = 'DHCP'
+        result.append(option)
+    return result
+
+
+def validate_ip_addr_type(ip, arg_spec, module):
+    '''Validate the address and map the generic input to its WAPI field.'''
+    if validate_ip_address(ip):
+        obj_type, address_field = NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS, 'ipv4addr'
+    elif validate_ip_v6_address(ip):
+        obj_type, address_field = NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS, 'ipv6addr'
+    else:
+        module.fail_json(msg='ipaddr must be a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address')
+
+    arg_spec[address_field] = arg_spec.pop('ipaddr')
+    module.params[address_field] = module.params.pop('ipaddr')
+    return obj_type, arg_spec, module
+
+
+def main():
+    option_spec = dict(
+        name=dict(),
+        num=dict(type='int'),
+        value=dict(required=True),
+        use_option=dict(type='bool', default=True),
+        vendor_class=dict(default='DHCP')
+    )
+
+    ib_spec = dict(
+        name=dict(required=True),
+        ipaddr=dict(required=True, ib_req=True, update=False),
+        mac=dict(required=True, ib_req=True, update=False),
+        network=dict(required=True, ib_req=True, update=False),
+        network_view=dict(default='default', ib_req=True, update=False),
+        options=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=option_spec, transform=options),
+        extattrs=dict(type='dict'),
+        comment=dict()
+    )
+
+    argument_spec = dict(state=dict(default='present', choices=['present', 'absent']))
+    argument_spec.update(ib_spec)
+    argument_spec.update(WapiModule.provider_spec)
+    argument_spec['provider'] = dict(WapiModule.provider_spec['provider'], required=True)
+
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+
+    # Collect the identifying fields while they still use the public names.
+    obj_filter = dict((key, module.params[key]) for key, value in iteritems(ib_spec)
+                      if value.get('ib_req'))
+    obj_type, ib_spec, module = validate_ip_addr_type(obj_filter['ipaddr'], ib_spec, module)
+
+    result = WapiModule(module).run(obj_type, ib_spec)
+    module.exit_json(**result)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from ansible.modules.net_tools.nios import nios_fixed_address
+from ansible.module_utils.net_tools.nios import api
+from units.compat.mock import MagicMock, patch
+from units.modules.utils import AnsibleExitJson, AnsibleFailJson, ModuleTestCase, set_module_args
+
+
+class TestNiosFixedAddress(ModuleTestCase):
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestNiosFixedAddress, self).setUp()
+        self.connector = MagicMock()
+        self.connector.get_object.return_value = None
+        connector_patch = patch('ansible.module_utils.net_tools.nios.api.get_connector',
+                                return_value=self.connector)
+        connector_patch.start()
+        self.addCleanup(connector_patch.stop)
+
+    def run_module(self, **overrides):
+        args = dict(name='printer', ipaddr='192.0.2.10', mac='00:11:22:33:44:55',
+                    network='192.0.2.0/24', provider={})
+        args.update(overrides)
+        set_module_args(args)
+        with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson) as result:
+            nios_fixed_address.main()
+        return result.exception.args[0]
+
+    def test_ipv4_create_and_options(self):
+        result = self.run_module(options=[dict(num=6, value='192.0.2.1')],
+                                 extattrs={'Site': 'lab'}, comment='printer')
+        self.assertTrue(result['changed'])
+        obj_type, obj = self.connector.create_object.call_args[0]
+        self.assertEqual(obj_type, api.NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS)
+        self.assertEqual(obj['ipv4addr'], '192.0.2.10')
+        self.assertEqual(obj['options'], [dict(num=6, value='192.0.2.1',
+                                               use_option=True, vendor_class='DHCP')])
+        self.assertEqual(obj['extattrs'], {'Site': {'value': 'lab'}})
+        self.assertEqual(obj['comment'], 'printer')
+        self.assertEqual(self.connector.get_object.call_args[0][1],
+                         dict(ipv4addr='192.0.2.10', mac='00:11:22:33:44:55',
+                              network='192.0.2.0/24', network_view='default'))
+
+    def test_ipv4_create_check_mode(self):
+        result = self.run_module(_ansible_check_mode=True)
+        self.assertTrue(result['changed'])
+        self.connector.create_object.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_ipv4_update_check_mode(self):
+        self.connector.get_object.return_value = [dict(_ref='fixedaddress/ref',
+                                                        name='printer', ipv4addr='192.0.2.10',
+                                                        mac='00:11:22:33:44:55',
+                                                        network='192.0.2.0/24',
+                                                        network_view='default', comment='old')]
+        result = self.run_module(comment='new', _ansible_check_mode=True)
+        self.assertTrue(result['changed'])
+        self.connector.update_object.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_ipv6_update_then_idempotent(self):
+        current = dict(_ref='ipv6fixedaddress/ref', name='printer',
+                       ipv6addr='2001:db8::10', mac='00:11:22:33:44:55',
+                       network='2001:db8::/64', network_view='default',
+                       comment='old', options=[dict(name='domain-name', value='example.com',
+                                                    use_option=True, vendor_class='DHCP')])
+        self.connector.get_object.return_value = [current]
+        args = dict(ipaddr='2001:db8::10', network='2001:db8::/64',
+                    comment='new', options=[dict(name='domain-name', value='example.com')])
+        result = self.run_module(**args)
+        self.assertTrue(result['changed'])
+        self.connector.update_object.assert_called_once()
+        self.assertEqual(self.connector.update_object.call_args[0][0], 'ipv6fixedaddress/ref')
+        updated = self.connector.update_object.call_args[0][1]
+        self.assertEqual(updated['comment'], 'new')
+        self.assertNotIn('network_view', updated)
+        self.assertEqual(self.connector.get_object.call_args[0][0], api.NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS)
+
+        current['comment'] = 'new'
+        current['_ref'] = 'ipv6fixedaddress/ref'
+        self.connector.update_object.reset_mock()
+        result = self.run_module(**args)
+        self.assertFalse(result['changed'])
+        self.connector.update_object.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_ipv6_absent_check_mode(self):
+        self.connector.get_object.return_value = [dict(_ref='ipv6fixedaddress/ref',
+                                                        ipv6addr='2001:db8::10')]
+        result = self.run_module(ipaddr='2001:db8::10', network='2001:db8::/64',
+                                 state='absent', _ansible_check_mode=True)
+        self.assertTrue(result['changed'])
+        self.connector.delete_object.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_ipv6_absent_selects_matching_mac_and_network(self):
+        self.connector.get_object.return_value = [
+            dict(_ref='ipv6fixedaddress/other', ipv6addr='2001:db8::10',
+                 mac='00:11:22:33:44:66', network='2001:db8::/64',
+                 network_view='default'),
+            dict(_ref='ipv6fixedaddress/wanted', ipv6addr='2001:db8::10',
+                 mac='00:11:22:33:44:55', network='2001:db8::/64',
+                 network_view='default')]
+        result = self.run_module(ipaddr='2001:db8::10', network='2001:db8::/64',
+                                 state='absent')
+        self.assertTrue(result['changed'])
+        self.connector.delete_object.assert_called_once_with('ipv6fixedaddress/wanted')
+
+    def test_options_omit_explicit_none(self):
+        module = MagicMock()
+        module.params = {'options': [dict(name='domain-name', num=None, value='example.com',
+                                          use_option=None, vendor_class=None)]}
+        self.assertEqual(nios_fixed_address.options(module),
+                         [dict(name='domain-name', value='example.com')])
+
+    def test_invalid_ip_and_option(self):
+        for args in (dict(ipaddr='not-an-ip'),
+                     dict(options=[dict(value='value')])):
+            values = dict(name='printer', ipaddr='192.0.2.10',
+                          mac='00:11:22:33:44:55', network='192.0.2.0/24', provider={})
+            values.update(args)
+            set_module_args(values)
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson):
+                nios_fixed_address.main()
+        self.connector.create_object.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_provider_is_required(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(name='printer', ipaddr='192.0.2.10',
+                             mac='00:11:22:33:44:55', network='192.0.2.0/24'))
+        with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson):
+            nios_fixed_address.main()
